"import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch plane
# Local (u, v) -> Global (x, y, z) = (0, u, v)
P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

# Local sketch coordinates for the four endpoints of the open chain
local_points = [
    (-5, 8),    # Line 1 start
    (14, 8),    # Line 1 end / Line 2 start (coincident)
    (14, 22),   # Line 2 end / Line 3 start (coincident)
    (-2, 22)    # Line 3 end
]

# Convert local coordinates to global (world) coordinates on the YZ plane
world_points = [P.toWorldCoords(p) for p in local_points]

# Create exactly three line edges (open orthogonal chain)
edges = [
    cq.Edge.makeLine(world_points[0], world_points[1]),  # Line 1: (-5, 8) -> (14, 8)
    cq.Edge.makeLine(world_points[1], world_points[2]),  # Line 2: (14, 8) -> (14, 22)
    cq.Edge.makeLine(world_points[2], world_points[3])   # Line 3: (14, 22) -> (-2, 22)
]

# Export the three edges as a STEP file (no solids, no bodies, no extra geometry)
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
